products.title: Counterculture: Counters & Submissions by Geo Martinez
products.body:
Enter the Counterculture with 10th Planet’s Geo Martinez and Escape, Defend, and Counter with Some of The Most Unorthodox and Effective Techniques in The game
  • Geo “Freakazoid” Martinez is a 3rd Degree Black Belt under Eddie Bravo and one of 10th Planet’s most decorated and recognized figures, with an ADCC Trials Title and multiple EBI Titles to his credit
  • Learn these unique “freak style” escapes and counters to completely revolutionize your defense and put you back on the attack
  • Escape high percentage submissions like the armbar, kimura, guillotine, and more with 10th Planet style details that you won’t see anywhere else
  • Attack with your own devastating subs as you exit from dangerous positions using seamless transitions and signature movement from Geo’s own personal toolbox
  • Dismantle and escape a fully locked triangle, survive the spiderweb position, exit the honeyhole unscathed, unlock the north south pin, and  much much more in this comprehensive guide to removing yourself from horrible spots and getting back on the attack
  • Develop strong defense that will give you an increased sense of confidence in your entire game and the tools to survive some of BJJ’s most dangerous attacks

products.title: Leg Lock Obsession by Quentin Rosenzweig
products.body:
Learn The 10th Planet Twist On Leglocks

  • Uncover 10th Planet Leg Locking Secrets With Quentin Rosensweig’s Guide For Attacking The Lower Body
  • Attack the lower body with effective and dynamic submissions, with this systematic approach that anyone can learn, with a focus on the super effective ways to finish with heel hooks.
  • Attack with confidence from leg lock battles and finish fights with these effective and efficient systems.


Learn The 10th Planet Twist On Leglocks...

Uncover 10th Planet Leg Locking Secrets With Quentin Rosensweig’s Guide For Attacking The Lower Body

What Will You Learn?

Learn the modern leg lock game from up-and-coming leg lock artist Quentin Rosensweig. Attack the lower body with effective and dynamic submissions, with this systematic approach that anyone can learn, with a focus on the super effective ways to finish with heel hooks. With new and innovative attacks from top and bottom, and packed with transitions, this is a guide that any grappler can follow to have one of the most technical and aggressive leg locking styles around.

Submission-only stylist Quentin Rosensweig shows the 10th Planet leg lock game that he uses in competition, including the transitions from finishing position to finishing position that turn good leg lockers into great ones. Quentin shows all the intricate details that go into the best heel hooks, taken step-by-step so anyone can learn them, and the 10th Planet-style systems he uses in ashi garami battles.

Build from the fundamentals to advanced leg locking principles with Quentin’s progressive attacks. These techniques will give you tons of opportunities to get to the legs, even from bad positions like the mount and back control. Learn all of these slick leg lock entries that work so that you can start attacking heel hooks and finishing fights way more effectively.

Attack with confidence from leg lock battles and finish fights with these effective and efficient systems. 10th Planet leg lock ace Quentin Rosensweig coaches you through his favorite and most common entries to 4/11, outside ashi, and 50/50 (including some of 10th Planet’s unique leg locking philosophies and secrets).

So What Do You Get?

Part 1:

  • Intro 
  • Standing Heel Hook 
  • Guitar String Straight Ankle 
  • Backstep in Shallow Cross 4/11 
  • Outside Heel Hook from Paulson Guard 
  • Heel Hook from Combat Base to Ashi 
  • Goon Heel Hook from Half Guard with Heel Hook option from Ashi
  • Atomic Wedge inside Heel to Backtake option 
  • Reverse Triangle to Double Outside Ashi 

Part 2:

  • Twister Side to 4/11 with Superman Chest Split Leg Finish
  • Double 4/11 from Side Mount
  • 4/11 from Mount to Heel Hook
  • 4/11 from Butterfly to heel hook
  • Back escape to 4/11 Power Straight Ankle
  • Closed Guard Straight Arm Lock to 50/50 Heel Hook
  • Pendulum 4/11 sit up to Heel Hook 
  • Butterfly half to outside ashi heel hook

Part 3:

  • Tornado from Half Guard to 4/11 Heel Hook 
  • Electric to outside Ashi Heel Hook 
  • Electric Chair to 4/11 Heel Hook 
  • Butterfly to 4/11 Heel Hook 
  • Arm Drag to Butterfly to Ashi Heel Hook 
  • Ashi Counter to Shin Ride to 4/11 Heel Hook 
  • Arm Bar Defense to Belly Down 4/11 Heel Hook

Part 4:

  • Figure Four Leg Lock when Opponent attacks your back
  • Splitting 50/50 to inside Heel Hook 
  • Wrong Side Straight Ankle to Z Lock from 50/50 
  • Short Straight Ankle against Ashi Defense 
  • 4/11 Concepts

products.title: Countering with Crab Ride by Anthony Budion
products.body:
Unlock the power of one of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu's most effective, yet underutilized, positions with Countering with Crab Ride by Anthony Budion. This groundbreaking instructional focuses on the crab ride, a dominant position that will elevate your top game and allow you to control and submit your opponents in ways you've never imagined.

  • Taught by Anthony Budion, a black belt under both Lucas Lepri and Jacare, and a 10th Planet black belt under Sean Applegate, this series combines traditional BJJ techniques with the dynamic, unorthodox principles of the 10th Planet system.
  • With years of experience at the highest levels, Budion offers an in-depth look at the crab ride and demonstrates how to apply it effectively across a variety of scenarios—whether in competition or in the gym.
  • What makes this series truly unique is its systemized approach to the crab ride. You'll learn how to counter attacks, create opportunities, and use the crab ride to dominate positions, sweeps, and submissions across the board.



Check Out a Free Sample:

What will You Learn?

Unlock the power of one of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu's most effective, yet underutilized, positions with Countering with Crab Ride by Anthony Budion. This groundbreaking instructional focuses on the crab ride, a dominant position that will elevate your top game and allow you to control and submit your opponents in ways you've never imagined.

Taught by Anthony Budion, a black belt under both Lucas Lepri and Jacare, and a 10th Planet black belt under Sean Applegate, this series combines traditional BJJ techniques with the dynamic, unorthodox principles of the 10th Planet system. With years of experience at the highest levels, Budion offers an in-depth look at the crab ride and demonstrates how to apply it effectively across a variety of scenarios—whether in competition or in the gym.

What makes this series truly unique is its systemized approach to the crab ride. You'll learn how to counter attacks, create opportunities, and use the crab ride to dominate positions, sweeps, and submissions across the board. This is not just about using the crab ride in one area of your game—it's about integrating it into every aspect of your Jiu-Jitsu.

Take your top game to the next level and build an adaptable, unstoppable system with Countering with Crab Ride. Whether you're a beginner looking to add a powerful tool to your arsenal, or an advanced practitioner seeking to refine your control and submission strategies, this series is a must-have.

Bullet Points:

  • Taught by Anthony Budion: Black belt under Lucas Lepri, Jacare, and 10th Planet black belt under Sean Applegate, with years of experience at the highest level of competition.

  • Systemized Approach: Learn how to apply the crab ride across all areas of your BJJ game, from sweeps and submissions to counters and positional control.

  • Unique and Unorthodox: This series focuses on the rarely taught crab ride, a position that is often overlooked but incredibly effective when used properly.

  • Detailed Instruction: Step-by-step breakdowns of key techniques, counters, and transitions that will enhance your top game and positional dominance.

  • Adaptable for All Levels: Whether you're a beginner or advanced practitioner, this instructional provides valuable insights and tools to incorporate into your game.

  • Practical for Competition: Learn how to use the crab ride effectively in both gi and no-gi competition, making this a versatile addition to your training.

  • Develop a New Game: Transform your Jiu-Jitsu with a fresh, dynamic approach that emphasizes creativity and control.
